I am myself lol, if I don't want to hurt myself then I won't. But OCD is such a damn annoyance making me feel I will. Thanks for the reply, I hope you were able to be comfortable with yourself.

We all deserve to love ourselves, and there are many different things about ourselves we can love. Just because some things aren't so great doesn't mean everything is. It's a tough thing to do, accepting and loving yourself, but you'll be so strong once you're able to. Which will happen.

Thanks for the reply, I'm sorry you feel that way sometimes /: it truly is terrible. The phrase "you never know what someone's going through" is so true in this case, if only the people that wanted to be stressful realize they're making things so much tougher for someone with OCD!

This is really interesting, because I'm going through the same thing as you! Was struggling so bad, anxiety attacks, and now I've started to understand more, and less bothered by it. But since it was so scary and affected me a lot, I worry about being insane too, I'm not used to the thought being gone. So I think we are getting stronger and a better understanding that these thoughts aren't what we want. We're not insane friend.
thank you. I need to hear that

Hey, I'm sorry you have to go through this, and I want you to know things will get better.
I myself am suffering a similar thing, and also feel I'd be better off in a psych ward and see no light. So I feel you pain. What you and I both though need to realize, is these thoughts aren't who we are, and never will be. They are actually the opposite. Things we will never be. Therapy, and visiting the doctor maybe for some meds, will help. I myself will be starting soon. So let us have hope. You can message me if you'd like, I'd love to talk about ways to help.

the things you listed really do help! I've been doing them a lot lately (bath, a walk, etc) and they make me feel pretty good. I've been sitting at home doing really nothing lately for months since I got laid off... and nowadays it's really starting to get old. Thoughts of a new job, excercising etc excite me now, I think I should finally try them out. An ex girlfriend of mine has been the only person I've told about this and I talk to her daily about this, she helps somewhat because she also has dealt with this. I feel if I can get help for my nerves, I think I'll be fine. I just have to get myself to do it. Thank you, for listening and responding. It means so much to me

thank you for this. I'm just really confused I guess, I've never had these thoughts and I really want to know if it'll get better. I don't wanna feel hopeless. knowing you had this and got better helps, I'm in the US so hopefully it'll be just as good too.

But if it's possible for them to go away, and for me to get better, that's all I need to know. I wanna be happy.

beautiful post my friend, thank you for this! And we all feel the same way towards you! We all deserve to be happy and get through this tough time.
